measurement_priorities.item: 裸底盘总质量及质量范围
measurement_priorities.method: Confirm exact R5 24V/27 four-wheel version, packing list; weigh chassis with documented wheels/motors/gearboxes/boards inclusion; weigh each wheel and remaining body.
measurement_priorities.reason: 5.7 kg dominates modeled mass, split and inclusion lack evidence.

measurement_priorities.method: Verify P7120S variant and weigh battery without charger; measure pose relative to base_footprint/axle midpoint; obtain CAD or balance-based local COM. Preserve uncertainty.
measurement_priorities.reason: 3.05 kg, about one third of model mass; mount is assumed.

measurement_priorities.item: 车载 BOM 与遗漏部件
measurement_priorities.method: Separate onboard/offboard/bundled items; weigh electronics, power/safety components, cables, brackets, four TFmini; record mounting XYZ and ownership to avoid double counts.
measurement_priorities.reason: Unknown omitted masses cannot be bounded or set to zero; ordering is provisional.

measurement_priorities.method: Decide actual gimbal architecture; weigh complete actuator/brackets/camera assembly and SEN0374; record mounts and density/centroid data.
measurement_priorities.reason: 180 g gimbal and 80 g IMU are engineering values.

measurement_priorities.method: After fixed assembly, record total weight and per-wheel/front-rear static loads on level surface, axle geometry and device condition; derive horizontal COM with uncertainty. Do not infer vertical COM from level loads alone.
measurement_priorities.reason: Independent closure check against component-derived COM; real measured loads are Earth-gravity observations, not lunar simulation validation.

interpretation: Source audit only. No full hardware measurements, no mass redistribution, no new simulation.
